prologue.text: Darkness and silence surround you. Somewhere far away a voice is singing, low and old.

options.name: Where am I? What is going on?
options.text: You wake on a bed of dry bracken in a hollow under a hill. Your memory is a fog: only your name remains, and a feeling that you were brought here for a reason.

options.name: (Continue)
options.text: A small fire crackles near the mouth of the hollow. Beside it sits an old man in a grey cloak and a tall pointed hat, puffing on a long pipe and watching you as if he had expected you.

options.name: Been here, done that. Show me to the enemies. (New Game+)
options.text: Skipping all that hard work somebody put into the dialog: the way out of the hollow opens and you can leave.

declinedDialog.text: Come back tomorrow and perhaps I'll have something that you'll actually be willing to do.

options.name: (Catching the not so subtle hint, you leave.)

stages.name: Talk to the old wizard
stages.description: There is not much to do in here other than talk to him, and any news is more than you have now.

stages.name: Leave the hollow
stages.description: The way out is open and you can leave now.

epilogue.text: Outside, the green hills of the Shire roll away under a wide sky. The old wizard spoke of a growing Shadow in the East, but is that your fight? Fog or no fog, you are sure you can look after yourself.

options.name: I want to stand against the Shadow (Future release)
options.text: Shouting "Where is the Enemy?" into the Shire will not get you far. Travel to the nearest settlement and ask around for news.

options.name: (Continue)
options.text: New Quest: A Chat with the Locals - Objective: Travel to any town.

options.name: I want to explore Middle-earth (brief tutorial)
I want to make a name for myself (Future release)
options.text: Then go and impress some people. But first you need some impressive spells. Build your collection to begin your quest.

epilogue.text: Like most small towns, this one has more shops and market stalls than houses: much of its folk come in from the farms around it each morning.

options.name: (Continue)
options.text: Many merchants are selling their wares. The ones that matter most to a spellcaster have colourful (if at times crude) signs in front of their shops.

options.name: (Continue)
options.text: The inn sounds just noisy enough to know it is doing good business. You recall what the old wizard said about the challenge coins and think about using them there.

options.name: (Continue)
options.text: Most interesting of all is the notice board in front of the town hall, offering work for adventurers. What better way to earn some coin while you explore?

declinedDialog.text: Come back tomorrow and perhaps I'll have something that you'll actually be willing to do.

options.name: (Catching the not so subtle hint, you leave.)

stages.name: Travel to town
stages.description: Find a friendly settlement to be introduced to the services it offers.

prologue.text: Every notable place in Middle-earth is either a town or a dungeon.

options.name: (Continue)
options.text: A navigation arrow now appears around your character. Follow it to a nearby town, and try to avoid any enemies on the way.

options.name: (Continue)
options.text: Hint: follow a road. All roads lead to a town. You also move faster on roads, and fewer enemies appear there.

stages.name: Leave town
stages.description: Head back out into the wilderness when you are ready to proceed.

prologue.text: Most towns in a region of Middle-earth look much alike and offer the same basic services.

options.name: (Continue)
options.text:
The inn contains some special events. You can also sell extra cards there, or buy temporary extra health.

The '?' sign denotes a town square or a job board where you can obtain side quests.

All of the other buildings with signs out front are shops, most of them sell cards.

To leave town, walk back toward the edge of the screen just below your current location.

options.name: (Continue)
options.text:
Entering a friendly town will also restore any missing hit points for free.

Explore the town if you want, and leave when you are ready to continue.

prologue.text: Your navigation arrow should now direct you to the nearest dungeon. Many quests will send you to dungeons, but you are also free to enter them without a quest. Follow the arrow and travel to a dungeon.
Many quests you undertake in your adventure will send you to one or more dungeons just like this one. Dungeons are filled with enemies, but also treasure like gold, mana shards, and cards.

options.name: (Continue)
options.text: Your next objective is to defeat any single enemy in a duel. You can find them in a dungeon like this one, or wandering around outside on the world map. To begin a duel, simply walk into the enemy.

options.name: (Continue)
options.text: If you are defeated by the enemy, that is okay. When that happens you lose some of your starting health and part of your gold, but you have learned what to expect from that enemy in the future.

options.name: (Continue)
options.text: Unlike on the world map, an enemy that defeats you in a dungeon will remain on the map; you can try to duel them again, or run away and seek out another opponent. If you want or need to heal yourself, go back to town.

options.name: (Continue)
options.text: Some quests, like this one, have multiple objectives that can be achieved simultaneously. Your other current objective is to find and enter a cave on the world map. An enemy defeated in a cave or on the way there will count as the enemy to defeat for your first objective, so feel free to do these things in any order.

epilogue.text: Winning a duel grants you rewards; usually a combination of gold and cards. Some enemies drop a wider assortment of cards for variety, but others specifically give cards from their own deck. If you still need to visit a cave, do that now. Otherwise, it's time to return to town.

A cave is functionally identical to a dungeon, but can be classified separately for quest purposes; a cave would not have completed your objective to find a dungeon, nor would that dungeon count for this one.

options.name: (Continue)
options.text: If you haven't defeated an enemy in a duel yet, you can pick a fight with an enemy here for that. Otherwise, you can return to town.

stages.name: Go to a town
stages.description: Go to one of the nearby settlements.

prologue.text:
It's not a bad idea to occasionally visit town to sell extra cards, browse the shops, or pick up new quests.

Every town has its own assortment of shops and thus its own unique collections of cards for sale.
